label: Weekend of Nov 13–15
note: Ranks are MHR’s Nov 11 ratings; they move live as results come in. Game times are local to the rink.

summary: Friday morning at the Little Caesars Challenger Cup: Windy City Storm (#36, 93.44) beat Biggby Coffee (#18, 95.03) 3-1, and Fox Motors (#35, 93.55) beat Boston Jr Eagles (#19, 94.94) 4-1. Those are the two upsets so far.
Ontario teams started strong. Toronto Jr Canadiens shut out Top Gun (#10, 96.39) 3-0, Chatham-Kent beat Seacoast (#22) 4-1, and Upper Canada College beat Cleveland 4-1.
The favorites held: Little Caesars blanked Chicago Fury 4-0, Team Illinois beat Huron-Perth 4-0, Penguins Elite beat Hill Academy 4-2, and Nashville edged Masters 3-2.
Team Illinois (now #4, 97.12) moves past Woodbridge, and Chicago Mission (#6, 97.10) is just behind both without playing.
